title: MeetingsCommon
description: Pieces the meetings contracts share. Not a document on its own.

instant.description: ISO 8601 with a zone, as Daybreak's .iso8601 date strategy writes it.

eventKey.description: Daybreak's MeetingEventKey: the calendar's UID for the event plus the occurrence (the calendar row's sourceID without its calendar: prefix), or row:<id> for a meeting with no UID. Encoded as a plain string (see MAPPING.md).

speaker.title: Speaker
speaker.description: you is the owner's own track (the mic); them is everyone else (the meeting app's audio).

fileName.description: A file name inside the note's own folder. Never a path.

sourceKind.title: NoteSourceKind
sourceKind.description: Daybreak's NoteSource.kind, as note.json writes it: the Mac's audio tap, the iPhone's mic, a meeting bot, an import of another tool's notes or transcript, or text uploaded directly (Daybreak M3). The hosted store spells these as hostedSourceKind.

summaryState.title: SummaryState
summaryState.description: Where a summary stands (Daybreak SummaryState, flattened). Never runs without a transcript or notes.

consentPath.title: ConsentPath
consentPath.description: How a recording was allowed to start (Daybreak consent.json). The private Already-agreed list itself is never exported.

noteSource.title: NoteSource
noteSource.description: A capture that filled a note.

tracks.description: File names in the note's folder: them.m4a, you.m4a.

hostedSourceKind.title: MeetingSourceKind
hostedSourceKind.description: Where a source on the hosted store came from: mac-tap, iphone-mic and bot are captures (Daybreak's macTap, iphoneMic, bot); import is another tool's notes or transcript brought in by Daybreak; upload is text sent straight to the store.

meetingID.description: The store's id for a meeting, safe in a URL path. When the meeting comes from Daybreak it may be a hash of the event key (for example lowercase hex SHA-256); the raw eventKey always travels in the body.

isWork.description: A work (AD) meeting. Its transcript is kept on the store (decision 16) but never published: a work publication is summary and items only.

remote.title: NoteRemote
remote.description: Daybreak M3: where note.json stands on the hosted meeting store.

serviceID.description: The store's meetingID for this note.

lastUploadedRevision.description: The store's revision after the last upload that went through; absent before the first.

uploadState.description: idle: nothing to send (never uploaded, or unchanged since). pending: changed on the Mac and waiting to upload. uploaded: the store has lastUploadedRevision. failed: the last upload didn't go through; lastError says why.
